# splode v0.3.1 - Table of Contents

Splode helps you deal with errors and exceptions in your application that are aggregatable and consistent.

## GUIDES

- [Get Started with Splode](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/get-started-with-splode.md)

## Modules

- [Splode](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/Splode.md): Use this module to create your error aggregator and handler.
- [Splode.Error](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/Splode.Error.md): Use this module to create an aggregatable error.
- [Splode.ErrorClass](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/Splode.ErrorClass.md): Tools for working with error classes
- [Splode.Stacktrace](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/Splode.Stacktrace.md): A placeholder for a stacktrace so that we can avoid printing it everywhere

- Exceptions
  - [Splode.Error.Unknown](https://splode.hexdocs.pm/Splode.Error.Unknown.md): The default top level unknown error container
